# twd

> twd is a self-hosted, tailnet-native runtime for Cloudflare-style Workers and Durable Objects on stock workerd. Every workload and every Durable Object instance is its own Tailscale tailnet node; callers are identified by WireGuard identity (`getCaller`), not tokens. You drive it with the `twd` CLI; every command takes `--json`.

Coding agents: start with the skills. `twd agent setup` installs them for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and OpenCode; `twd agent show <skill>` prints one; `twd docs search <words>` and `twd docs show <doc>[#<anchor>]` read these docs offline, at the version of the installed CLI.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/README.md): what twd is, the quick start, and the compatibility table
- [Docs map](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/README.md): every doc by role and by task (learn, do, look up, understand)
- CLI reference: `twd help` lists every command with its flags; `twd <command> --help` shows one
- [Using twd with a coding agent](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/agents.md): skills, `twd agent setup`, safety rules
- [Agent skills](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/agent/skills/twd/SKILL.md): the core skill; the others are next to it in agent/skills/
- [Installing twd](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/INSTALL.md): macOS and Linux, OAuth client, `twd link`, hosts, troubleshooting
- [Upgrading twd](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/upgrading.md): what may run together, `twd upgrade`, fleet upgrade runs, cordon and drain
- [Releasing twd](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/RELEASING.md): versions, release-note fragments, the release gates
- [Running twd on Headscale](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/headscale.md): the Headscale profile, `twd up --control=headscale`, what's different from Tailscale

## Building apps

- [twd.jsonc reference](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/twd-jsonc.md): every key, tags and `twd init`
- [Using wrangler with twd](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/wrangler.md): wrangler.toml/json/jsonc, `--env`, bundling, what's ignored
- [Cloudflare Workers compatibility](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/COMPAT.md): what works, surface by surface, with the tests behind it
- [Worker secrets](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/secrets.md): `twd secret`, `.dev.vars`
- [Workers KV](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/kv.md): `kv_namespaces`, `twd kv`, consistency and limits
- [R2 buckets](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/r2.md): `r2_buckets` bindings, the `fs` / `s3` blob backends, `twd r2`
- [D1 databases](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/d1.md): `d1_databases`, wrangler migrations, `twd d1`, sessions and limits
- [Queues](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/queues.md): `queues.producers` / `queues.consumers`, `queue()`, retries, dead-letter queues, `twd queues`
- [Cron triggers](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/cron-triggers.md): `triggers.crons`, `scheduled()`
- [Workflows and approvals](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/approvals.md): Cloudflare Workflows, `AgentWorkflow`, `waitForApproval`; approvals decided by tailnet identities under `twd.dev/cap/approve`, `twd approve`
- [Public ingress (Funnel)](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/public-ingress.md): public routes, `twd expose`
- [Tailscale Services](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/services.md): stable names and replicas
- [Locks and leader election](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/locks.md): Durable Objects as locks, leases, fencing tokens, the `lock` template, failure guarantees
- [Per-object egress](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/egress-modes.md): facet mode vs plain-DO mode
- [Create admission](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/create-admission.md): how a new Durable Object gets made
- [Containers and code sandboxes](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/containers.md): `ctx.container` on the microVM tier
- [The Node process tier](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/node-tier.md): `"runtime": "node"`

## Operating and debugging

- [CLI --json output](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/cli-json.md): result documents, NDJSON events, the error shape
- [CLI --json schema](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/schema/cli.schema.json): JSON Schema of every command's output
- [Observability](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/observability.md): request records (`twd logs`), Prometheus `/metrics`, OTLP export (`twd telemetry`), traces
- [Error catalog](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/docs/errors.md): every error code and its fix

- [twd.jsonc JSON Schema](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/twd/blob/master/schema/twd.schema.json): for editor completion
